The inbox is empty and all eight requests are decided.

- **Fulfilled (m1–m4):** Four SybilCo orders of 5,000 USD each, 20,000 in total. Attest allowed each one. SybilCo's stake is 20,000, and the orders came from two agents, each with its own 10,000 mandate and each at exactly 10,000.
- **Declined (m5–m8):** Four more SybilCo orders of 5,000 USD each, from two further agents. Attest refused each one because SybilCo already had 20,000 in orders over the last 30 days. That is the most its stake backs, and any more would go over it.

None of the requests needed escalation, since all were under 8,000 USD.

The orders came from several agents of the same operator. Their separate 10,000 mandates would have allowed more than SybilCo's stake backs, which is why Attest's operator-level exposure check stopped the later ones.
